# Interface assets

IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Mono are bundled under the SIL Open Font License in IBM-Plex-LICENSE.txt, reused from the approved local study.

Seven navigation SVGs and three processing accents were exported from the existing PacketPilot Figma design, file 0Y1NSOPaJLy8ZGyYGc88Hp, on 3 October 2026. Its component metadata describes original editable PacketPilot vectors. All assets are served locally, with no third-party requests during application use.

The flat answer-symbol branding and runtime-data diagrams are local SVG. These provenance notes describe the original asset set, not the current application framework. The current interface uses React and its declared dependencies. See [copied component notices](../../frontend/COPIED_COMPONENT_NOTICES.txt) and [built runtime notices](../react/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt). The bundled font licence and original vector provenance remain unchanged.
